keywords: EIP-8289 多区块访问列表预热
summary: 周日较安静。nerolation 提交 EIP-8289，让 EIP-2929 访问列表跨 256 个区块保持预热，而不是每笔交易重置，估计每区块 gas 中位数节省约 14%，代价约 10 MB 节点状态。Zcash 漏洞促成 Ironwood 项目，对 Orchard 支付电路做形式化验证。

items.title: 新 EIP：多区块访问列表预热
items.note: （nerolation）提交，即 EIP-8289。它加入一个 256 区块的滚动预热访问多重集合，通过区块头中的 SHA-256 SMT 根承诺，使 EIP-2929 访问列表跨区块延续：每区块 gas 中位数约省 14%，节点需多存约 10 MB 状态。
items.title_en: New EIP: Multi-block Access List Warming
items.note_en: (nerolation), submitted; this is EIP-8289. It adds a 256-block rolling warm access multiset, committed via a SHA-256 SMT root in the block header, so the EIP-2929 access list carries across blocks: a median gas saving of about 14% per block, for about 10 MB of extra node state.

summary_en: A quiet Sunday. nerolation submitted EIP-8289, which keeps the EIP-2929 access list warm across 256 blocks instead of resetting it per transaction, for an estimated median gas saving of about 14% per block at a cost of about 10 MB of node state. The Zcash bug led to Ironwood, a formal verification effort for the Orchard payment circuit.
